authorization_scope: Development planning only; no production/source/formal-input edits, build, solver, branch switch or remote server action in this turn

share.basis: User message summary plus local original papers and source, not an assumed shared transcript

first_release.continuum: single-layer saturated low-frequency displacement-pressure; relative water-solid acceleration neglected; skeleton acceleration retained in Darcy
first_release.water_storage: finite Kw linearized storage and reference water properties
first_release.porosity: dynamic; independent solid-volume/mass/inertia ledger must be closed before code
first_release.hydraulic_conductivity: constant isotropic k [m/s]; not intrinsic permeability [m2]. Uniform global value for first tests; later different materials may have distinct time-independent values
first_release.pressure_spatial_operator: candidate correction admitted only after independent consistency, hydrostatic, flux, stability and cost tests
first_release.time_integration: retain existing explicit finite-Kw integrator first
first_release.stress_precision: retain accepted double persistent stress; no global precision redesign
first_release.new_porosity_precision: evaluate one double n or equivalent J state against per-step ULP loss; avoid redundant drifting states
first_release.legacy_mode: current UPW_PR remains default and unaffected path

decisions: u-pl/u-pw names alone do not determine physics, spatial order or accuracy
Existing Morris is already a second spatial derivative; Lian disorder compensation is a separate numerical choice
Constant k is a justified first closure, not proof that local permeability evolution is always negligible
Matched low-frequency small-strain limits should agree; rapid-ramp/Cryer transients may differ
TPI changes the storage assumption and approximates a pressure constraint; not an unconditional larger-dt finite-Kw PR solver
Negative-pressure stabilization is plastic-dilatancy-specific and not a cavitation or unsaturated model

phases.gate: Document a consistent closure before new persistent arrays or coupled feedback

phases.scope: Independent CPU pressure-operator diagnostics; 2D then justified 3D
phases.gate: Polynomial/disorder/boundary/hydrostatic/flux/dissipation/convergence and observed cost; no assumed second-order rate

phases.scope: Porosity observer then coupled consistent fixed-k storage/volume/inertia state
phases.gate: Uniform deformation, shear/rigid nulls, (1-n)J invariant, approximation-aware mass residual; sorting/output/stage identity
Current completed stage acceleration, no duplicate old/new PR, accelerated equilibrium, undrained/quasistatic/harmonic and independent half checks

phases.scope: GPU synchronization and bounded-to-full physical comparisons
phases.gate: Native ID/actual-clock safety, same-model half and backend metrics, theory metrics separately; 1D then Cryer then Lian
Measured hydraulic vs mechanical limitation and equal-accuracy physical-time throughput; dedicated incompressible-limit reference

phases.scope: Plastic mini-tests and target Selborne readiness
phases.gate: Decide calibrated negative-pressure treatment and k(n) only with evidence; actual multi-material/regional-pressure implementation before enabling Selborne

mandatory_derivations: Current fixed MassFluid and solid-advected Velrhop.w cannot simply become physical mixture density after adding n
Continuous (1-ni) div(v) and Lian neighbor (1-nj) weighted Eq24 are not identical for heterogeneous n
Dimension-dependent 2D/3D Eq23 moments; changing coefficient 4 to5 alone is not complete 3D validation
Eq25 pressure compensation gamma normalization ambiguity: derive from Eq10+23 and SI dimensions; do not infer author implementation error
Whole-head compensation vs literal pressure-only compensation must pass hydrostatic balance
Local consistency correction and pair symC reciprocity differ; global conservation/dissipation not inherited
Full compressible water mass contains density-gradient transport omitted by the linearized storage approximation
Stage Ace excludes gravity until integration; damping/HG and post-force NoPen need explicit acceleration semantics
New spectrum/coupled stability must be checked; fixed dt currently bypasses automatic pore-dt clipping

implementation_notes.entry: Production pressure rate is fused in main force interactions; do not patch only the unused standalone dispatcher
implementation_notes.schedule: After same-stage completed forces/load normalization/damping/HG, a read-only neighbor pass; disable legacy rate accumulation for the new mode rather than adding a second full PR
implementation_notes.cost: Fixed-isotropic candidate can accumulate receiver grad p, scalar Laplacian, coordinate defect and div a locally; no global six-Hessian requirement or extra cell build assumed
implementation_notes.proposed_interface_not_implemented: One model enum e.g. HydroMechFormulation=UPW_PR/UPL_PR; test-stage switches remain in harness, TPI separate only when admitted
implementation_notes.old_tpi_keys: Remain explicitly rejected; archived controls/results do not count as current acceptance

validation_policy.legacy_default_off_regression: Complete same-physics native field comparison required; old physical evidence not automatically inherited
validation_policy.metric_scope: Historical elastic-case comparison starting points, not universal gates; P0 must predeclare appropriate dimensional/relative thresholds for manufactured fields, harmonic/plastic problems and the new density-volume closure
validation_policy.model_switch_scope: Separate fresh runs only until explicit mass/volume/n/history migration is derived and verified; no direct cross-model PART continuation
validation_policy.tpi_time_levels: Paper Leap-Frog staggered histories are not automatically the current Symplectic predictor/corrector arrays; startup, full/half-time history and variable-step extrapolation require derivation
validation_policy.cryer_reference: Retain actual drainage-relative clock, finite Kw and material observation radius; current three server runs untouched
validation_policy.selfweight_accuracy_repair: Still deferred except new-model hydrostatic/short consistency checks
validation_policy.two_dimensional_reference: Lian numerical SPH/FEM reference, not exact solution; Yao remains deferred

performance_metrics: natural hydraulic/mechanical dt and limiting fractions
cost per physical simulated time at matched accuracy
